owner_summaries.key_concerns: Entity-level TB balances not reconciled; FX rates coverage policy not met.

residual_risks.description: Entity-level TB balances remain unreconciled, leading to potential misstatements in consolidated financials.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Implement automated reconciliation tools and assign dedicated ownership for TB balance reviews.

residual_risks.description: FX rates coverage does not meet policy requirements, increasing exposure to currency risk.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Enhance FX rate monitoring processes and enforce policy adherence through periodic audits.

residual_risks.description: High flux analysis exceptions indicate potential issues in account variance monitoring.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Refine flux analysis thresholds and improve exception handling workflows.
